name: 185. Streamed Responses events keep their extra_fields on the OpenAI drop-in route (responses-stream-extra-fields)
description: Core stamps request_type, provider and routing_info on every streamed Responses event, and the native /v1/responses route writes the chunk as-is. The OpenAI drop-in /openai/v1/responses route re-renders each event through BifrostResponsesStreamResponse.WithDefaults(), which copied every event field except ExtraFields, so every event went out with a zero-valued extra_fields ({"request_type":"","routing_info":{},"latency":0,"chunk_index":0}) while the non-streaming WithDefaults kept it. The drop-in case asserts every event carries request_type and routing_info.provider (red before the fix); the native case pins the same invariant on the route that already worked. A non-OpenAI provider is used because the harness profile enables send_back_raw_response, which makes the OpenAI provider's events bypass WithDefaults as raw frames.
